concepts.def: A team that does one type of work
A person who leads a team
Levels of authority in a business
Senior leader who plans the future

walkthroughs.body_html:
Big businesses split work into departments:

  • Marketing — promotes products.
  • Finance — counts the money.
  • HR — looks after staff.
  • Operations — makes the product.

Front-line staff meet customers — shop floor, tills, call centre.

Back-office staff support them — payroll, IT, buying stock.

Both matter — no one works alone.

A business hierarchy is its layers:

  • Directors set the big plan.
  • Managers run teams.
  • Team members do the daily work.

Like a triangle: few at the top, many at the bottom. 🔺
